_about: The camera on the heroine (D83, 20.11.2026; wheel zoom D95, 21.11.2026; start zoom 1.5 instead of 2.25, D114, 22.11.2026: the team sees more of the room). zoom: the zoom a level starts at, how much closer than one room pixel per screen pixel (Artem 21.11: at 3 she sees only a few steps around her). The player changes it with the mouse wheel or the = and - keys (a trackpad pinch too), from the whole room on the screen out to zoom_max close in; the choice is kept between levels while the game is open. zoom_max: the closest view (3 = she is about 280 px tall on a 1080 screen, Boris 20.11). zoom_step: one wheel step multiplies the zoom by it (above 1, at most 2). zoom_speed: how fast the camera slides to the chosen zoom (per second). lead_px: how far ahead of her the camera looks in the direction she faces, in room pixels; lead_speed: how fast that look turns when she turns (per second). follow_speed: how fast the camera catches up with her. overview_start_seconds: the whole room is shown this long at the start of a level (any move key or the wheel ends it sooner). overview_blend_seconds: how long the camera takes between the overview and the close view. The overview is the whole room fitted into the screen; hold the 'overview' key (Tab) to see it. feet_screen_y: where her feet stand on the screen in the close view, from the top (0.5 the middle, 1 the bottom; Д5.1, Boris 20.11: not half a screen of floor); the camera still keeps to the room. ride_lead_px and ride_zoom (D168): while she rides the minecart of level 04 the camera looks ride_lead_px ahead along the ride and multiplies the zoom by ride_zoom (at most 1: it pulls back), so the next switch shows at least 3 s ahead.
